project_info.title: Soft look-back on neon rainy street

prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with loosely tied rain-damp dark hair wears an oversized vintage chunky winter sweater.
prompt.composition_elements: Continuous handheld smartphone POV follows her on wet pavement; she pauses, turns over her shoulder, waits for autofocus, smiles, and tucks a wet strand behind her ear.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Neon signs and street lamps reflect on wet pavement with delayed focus, high-ISO noise, dynamic blur, lens flare, and heavy grain.

technical_specs.motion: Shaky walking, delayed autofocus, look-back, smile, and hair tuck.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Low-quality smartphone vlog footage, shaky handheld camera POV. An adult woman with rain-damp, loosely half-tied long hair walks ahead on a wet neon street at night in an oversized vintage chunky winter sweater. Colorful lights reflect across the pavement. High ISO noise and motion blur. She pauses, turns back over her shoulder, waits for delayed autofocus to settle, and offers a casual warm smile before gently tucking a wet strand of hair behind her ear. Keep amateur framing, lens flares, heavy video grain, and a raw unpolished snapshot aesthetic in one continuous shot.
